data.name: Charishma
data.gender_notes: Charishma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charishma is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'charis', which means 'radiance' or 'shining'. It is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is believed to bestow her blessings upon those who live a virtuous and righteous life. The name Charishma carries the meaning “Radiance, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charishma usually hope their child will grow to embody radiance, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires radiance, inner light, and grace
data.etymology: Charishma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiance, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charishma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charishma has gained popularity in recent times due to its strong cultural connotation. In Hindu society, naming a child is a significant process, often with deep spiritual and cultural meanings associated. Charishma holds a special place in this tradition, as it invokes the image of the radiant and wealthy goddess Lakshmi. The name is widely used among Hindus and can be found in various regions of India, reflecting the diversity and richness of Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Charishma signifies grace, prosperity, and the blessings of the goddess Lakshmi. It is believed that the person bearing this name will be endowed with a radiant and shining personality, reflecting happiness, positivity, and prosperity. Charishma also symbolizes the divine grace bestowed upon the individual, striving to lead a virtuous and righteous life. The name inspires the person to strive for material and spiritual wealth, leading to overall success and happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charishma is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Radiant with Grace'. It signifies the innate beauty and charm that emanates from within, illuminating the individual and their environment.

vedic_reference.note: Charishma is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chari’ meaning chariot and ‘Ishm’ meaning God.

historical_references.reference: Charishma is mentioned in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, as the name of a divine apsara or celestial nymph who was blessed by Lord Shiva to grant boons to devotees.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata is an ancient Sanskrit epic, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, the other being the Ramayana. It is traditionally attributed to Vyasa and is a part of the Hindu itihasa literature.

historical_references.reference: Charishma is also mentioned in the Puranic literature as the name of a goddess, the wife of the god Indra. She is described as the mother of the god Vibhishana, who later becomes a key ally of Rama in the Ramayana.
historical_references.context: The Puranas are a set of 18 major Sanskrit texts dealing with various aspects of Hinduism. They were composed between the 4th and 8th centuries CE.
